question: Where can I find a university inside a 70 kilometers radius toward the north of AHN Cancer Institute, Erie, PA?
sql: WITH origin_poi AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%AHN Cancer Institute%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Erie%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.id, p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois AS p, origin_poi AS o WHERE p.amenity = 'university' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, o.geometry::geography, 70000) -- 70 kilometers in meters AND ( degrees(ST_Azimuth(o.geometry, p.geometry)) BETWEEN 337.5 AND 360 OR degrees(ST_Azimuth(o.geometry, p.geometry)) BETWEEN 0 AND 22.5 );
